column1: # Consolidated CMSketch and estimator source evidence.

column5: One canonical CMSketch/TopN family owns Murmur3, counter/noise arithmetic, merge, sampled TopN construction, stable ranking, scaling primitives, exact integer Datum EncodeValue/query including integer limits, nil-versus-empty CMS/TopN coding, and exact exercised tipb wire vectors. No production Rust planner/cardinality path calls query_integer_datum or owns CmsSketch yet. Histogram/statistics-handle integration, decoded display, session/timezone trace, failpoints, noninteger Datum encoding, and generated tipb ownership remain open.

All estimator branches preserve source arithmetic, copy-before-merge, half splitting, per-node negative clamp, defensive returns, and exact intest panic payloads; GEE is routed by the CMS/TopN builder, but the global-singleton estimator has no non-test Rust caller. Internal checks remain enabled in debug builds and are runtime-selectable in release builds; live analyze/planner routing remains open.
